title: RSVP Response Tracker
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:rsvp
| stats count as invited, sum(eval(if(response="yes",1,0))) as attending, sum(eval(if(response="no",1,0))) as declined, sum(eval(if(response="pending",1,0))) as pending
| eval response_rate=round(100*(attending+declined)/invited,1)
description: Counts invitations by response status so you know your head count and who still has not replied.
value: An accurate, live head count drives catering and seating decisions and flags who needs a gentle chase.
implementation: Ingest RSVP records into `index=personal`; tally responses and compute the response rate.
visualization: Pie chart of RSVP responses with a response-rate figure.
grandmaExplanation: It counts who has said yes, no, or nothing yet, so you know how many are coming and who to chase.
